name: blabee
description: Blabee contracts, Codex integration, and the macOS coordinator.

scripts.test: node --test --test-concurrency=1 Tests/Contracts/*.test.mjs Tests/CoordinatorCore/*.test.mjs Tests/CoordinatorOperational/*.test.mjs Tests/CoordinatorPersistence/*.test.mjs Tests/RuntimeQualification/*.test.mjs Tests/AppPackaging/*.test.mjs Tests/LocalDogfood/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:swift:test-app: env -u BLABEE_NATIVE_LIVE_VERIFY -u BLABEE_NATIVE_LIVE_EXECUTABLE -u BLABEE_PUBLIC_HOOK_NATIVE -u BLABEE_CLAUDE_PACKAGED_RUNTIME -u BLABEE_TEST_RECOVERY_KEYCHAIN -u BLABEE_SQLITE_RECEIPT_BENCHMARK -u BLABEE_SQLITE_QUEUED_CLAIM_BENCHMARK DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer /usr/bin/lockf -t 0 -k -w /tmp/blabee-coordinator-swift-tests.lock /usr/bin/xcrun swift test --package-path . --scratch-path /tmp/blabee-test-app-swift-tests --jobs 1 --disable-keychain --disable-netrc --experimental-maximum-parallelization-width 1 -Xswiftc -DBLABEE_TEST_APP --filter 'BlabeeTest(Profile|RunStore|Composition|Workspace|Engine|EngineService|EngineStorage)Tests'
